envelope.description: Host wiring: post history-list, title-from-first-prompt, provider validation

body.title: Host wiring: post history-list, title-from-first-prompt, provider validation
body.summary: In chat-panel.ts host: open() posts history-list (from deps.store.list()) after theme + session-restored; handleMessage re-posts history-list after new-chat/open-chat, and new-chat validates provider is a member of deps.providers.available before store.create (else no-op+warn); runTurn sets session.title from the first user prompt (trimmed/clipped; whitespace falls back to 'new chat') on the first turn via save(), and re-posts history-list after the terminal done. Preserve the cancelActive()+ ++generation single-in-flight guard and the existing native-resume wiring unchanged.
acceptanceChecks: open() posts theme + session-restored + history-list; history-list re-posted after new-chat/open-chat and after a turn's done
new-chat with a provider NOT in providers.available is a no-op (active session unchanged); valid provider creates a fixed-provider session
runTurn sets title from the first user prompt (empty->'new chat'); native resume path + single-in-flight guard unchanged; no workflow/daemon call (k8/k3)

tests.name: open() posts history-list (with theme + session-restored); history-list re-posted after new-chat/open-chat and after a turn's done
new-chat{provider:'codex'} creates a fixed-provider session; a non-available provider is a no-op (active session unchanged)
after a turn, session.title is set from the first user prompt and reflected in a re-posted history-list
